place_value.summary: Count, read, write and compare numbers to 100; begin recognising place value beyond 20 using objects and pictorial representations.

multiplication_division.summary: Solve one-step multiplication and division problems using concrete objects, pictorial representations and arrays; connect grouping/sharing with counting in 2s, 5s and 10s.

fractions.summary: Recognise, find and name halves and quarters of objects, shapes or quantities.

place_value.summary: Recognise tens and ones in two-digit numbers; read, write, compare and order numbers to at least 100 using multiple representations.

multiplication_division.summary: Use arrays, repeated addition, grouping and sharing; become fluent in 2, 5 and 10 times tables and related division facts; use commutativity and inverse relationships.

fractions.summary: Recognise and write thirds, quarters, halves and three-quarters of lengths, shapes, sets and quantities; recognise simple equivalence such as 2/4 = 1/2; count in fractions on a number line.

place_value.summary: Recognise hundreds, tens and ones in three-digit numbers; compare and order to 1,000; partition and represent numbers flexibly.

multiplication_division.summary: Develop fluency in multiplication/division facts and use them to solve increasingly structured problems; connect multiplication and division through inverse relationships.

fractions.summary: Understand unit and non-unit fractions as numbers, including on the number line; recognise simple equivalent fractions; compare fractions and add/subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole.

place_value.summary: Recognise four-digit place value, compare numbers beyond 1,000, round to nearest 10/100/1,000, and count backwards through zero into negative numbers.

multiplication_division.summary: Recall tables to 12×12; use factor pairs, commutativity, distributive reasoning and formal written multiplication/division with increasingly large numbers.

fractions.summary: Develop families of equivalent fractions, work with hundredths, connect fractions and decimals, and add/subtract fractions with the same denominator.

place_value.summary: Read, write, order and compare whole numbers to at least 1,000,000; extend understanding to negative numbers, rounding and decimals to thousandths.

multiplication_division.summary: Apply multiplication/division facts to larger calculations, use factors/multiples/prime numbers, and use formal written methods including multi-digit multiplication and division.

fractions.summary: Compare/order fractions, identify equivalents, convert improper/mixed numbers, add/subtract related denominators, multiply fractions by whole numbers, and connect fractions, decimals and percentages.

place_value.summary: Read, write, order and compare whole numbers to 10,000,000, round to required accuracy and use negative numbers in context.

multiplication_division.summary: Use fluent formal methods for multi-digit multiplication and division; interpret remainders flexibly and connect factors/common factors with fraction work.

fractions.summary: Simplify using common factors, compare/order fractions greater than one, add/subtract unlike denominators, multiply pairs of proper fractions, divide proper fractions by whole numbers, and connect fractions with decimals and percentages.
